# greedy without hard window constraint: minimize |window gc - 25|
def optimize_soft(prot, seed):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    dna = []
    for i, aa in enumerate(prot):
        cands = CODONS[aa][:]
        rng.shuffle(cands)
        best = None; best_score = None
        for c in cands:
            newdna = ''.join(dna) + c
